name: ecd-spectra
description: Precise extraction of experimental ECD spectra, measurement conditions, and stereochemical evidence from scientific literature.

interface.shortDescription: Recover ECD spectra, conditions, and stereochemical evidence.
interface.longDescription: An auditable visual workflow for separating single traces from multi-curve ECD plots, showing progress and diagnostic overlays, capturing experimental conditions and stereochemical evidence, and generating self-contained HTML and Markdown reports.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $extract-ecd-spectra to separate the requested experimental trace, show diagnostic overlays, and produce a validated numerical package with visual reports.
